aboutUsSubtitle: Learn Chinese with a clear goal, practical path and real support
aboutCVKContent: MOLY COURSE 2026 helps learners build Chinese foundations, prepare for HSK, HSKK and CSCA, and plan their study journey in China step by step.
learnReactHeading: Learning paths built around your goal
learnReactContent: At MOLY COURSE, you can start with a program that matches your current target:
learnReactList1: Build a strong Chinese foundation from zero.
learnReactList2: Prepare for HSK and HSKK with a clear level and timeline.
learnReactList3: Organize knowledge and practice for a CSCA goal.
learnReactList4: Prepare a study plan and information for studying in China.
learnReactCommitment: MOLY COURSE focuses on clear lessons, practical exercises and feedback that shows learners their next step.
aiLearningContent: Each lesson is designed to help you understand, apply and review what you learn:
aiLearningList1: Topic-based lessons that move from foundations to real use.
aiLearningList2: Personalized Learning Paths: AI will analyze your progress and strengths, weaknesses to suggest the most suitable learning path, optimizing learning efficiency.
aiLearningList3: Support through Zalo 0815913408 when you need help choosing a path or registering.
progressTrackingHeading: Track Progress and Build Learning Paths
progressTrackingContent: MOLY COURSE knows that sustainable progress needs regular review. You can:
progressTrackingList1: Track Learning Progress: The system automatically tracks completed lessons, study time, and exercise results, helping you easily grasp an overview of your learning process.
progressTrackingList2: Build a personal path based on your goal, level and available time.
progressTrackingList3: Track Goals: Set specific learning goals and track progress towards achieving them, helping you stay on track and not miss any steps.
startLearningCTA: Start your Chinese learning journey with MOLY COURSE today.
termsOfServiceContent: These terms explain account use, course access, learning content and the responsibilities of every MOLY COURSE 2026 learner.
termsOfServicePoint1: You are responsible for all activities that occur under your account.
termsOfServicePoint2: You must not use the platform for any illegal or unauthorized purpose.
termsOfServicePoint3: We reserve the right to modify or terminate the service at any time.
privacyPolicyContent: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacyPolicyPoint1: We collect information you provide when registering for an account, such as your name and email address.
privacyPolicyPoint2: We use your information to provide services, improve the platform, and communicate with you.
privacyPolicyPoint3: We do not share your personal information with third parties unless required by law or necessary to provide services.
copyrightPolicyContent: MOLY COURSE respects intellectual property rights. Lessons, materials, designs and brand assets are protected and may not be copied or redistributed without permission.
copyrightPolicyPoint1: If you believe your copyrighted work has been copied or used in a way that constitutes copyright infringement, please contact us.
copyrightPolicyPoint2: We respect the intellectual property rights of others and will respond to notices of alleged copyright infringement in accordance with applicable law.
disclaimerContent: MOLY COURSE information is provided for learning and general reference. Exam, scholarship, admission and immigration requirements can change, so always verify official notices.
disclaimerPoint1: We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from the use or inability to use the platform.
disclaimerPoint2: MOLY COURSE does not guarantee exam scores, scholarships, visas or admission outcomes.
contactUsContent: For support, contact MOLY COURSE through Zalo 0815913408, TikTok @moly_studio01 or the official Facebook page.
